message: Sree, we're gathering a small group of builders in SF next week—mostly folks working on developer tools, LLM infrastructure, and ML research. Louan from UCSF and Artem from Osmosis AI are confirmed, along with a few other operators doing serious work in the space. Your focus on making LLM optimization and medical imaging actually work in production feels like exactly the kind of pragmatism we need in the room. Want in?
